summary: Mendocino National Forest lookout on Big Signal Peak in the Sanhedrin Wilderness; the current summit structure dates to 1961 and its cab is decommissioned, with relay antennae.

facts.status_note: Cab decommissioned; microwave relay and other antennae are attached to the summit structure, per a 2019 trip report.

access.note: Inside the Sanhedrin Wilderness. The Forest Service calls the lookout at the end of Forest Road 20N04 the only public access point. No source read says the cab is open to visitors.

visit.trail_note: No developed trails in the Sanhedrin. A 2019 trip report says the spur road, 19N80, is steep and rough and no place for passenger cars.

corrections.why: The register dates the current summit structure to 1961 (opened 1962). Its description puts the first summit structure before 1923 and the second in 1933, so 1923 does not date the building standing today.

notes_for_editor: Built year: the record's 1923 is taken from the register's 'Circa 1923/1933/1961' field; the register text dates the current structure to 1961, so a correction is proposed, not applied. 1987 fire: the September 3 'destroyed' and September 13 'spared' items are quoted second-hand on the Forest Lookouts page; the original Ukiah Daily Journal items were not read, so the disagreement is reported, not resolved. Current status: no official 2020s source was read. The 2019 trip report is one visitor's account of a decommissioned cab with antennae. The FFLA California list row was not legible enough to confirm status. A search result mentioned a fire on private land near Little Signal Peak; its date and any effect on the lookout were not confirmed, so it is left out. Staffing: the 1992 note is the last staffing reference found. Access: the Forest Service page is the authority for public access. No climbing is encouraged. No new photos added; the record's register photos carry 'All rights reserved'.
